On Thu, 03 Dec 2026 11:13:00 -0000, Ben Carter <ben_carter@redwood.com> wrote:

Hi Alicia / team — looping in Marissa for questionnaire logistics and to capture any contract-level asks.

Short technical answers to Alicia's callouts and the items I'll put in the matrix: 
1) SOC 2 scope: Redwood will provide the latest SOC 2 Type II report. The report covers our hosted inference API and the control activities around logging, but we will include an explicit scope statement confirming whether third-party log aggregators are covered. If Helix requires the report to enumerate specific logging integrations, Marissa will coordinate an addendum.

2) HSM / BYOK options (high level):
- Option A: Cloud KMS with customer-managed keys (BYOK import). Keys are stored in cloud KMS backed by provider HSM; Redwood accesses keys via KMS API. If KMS is temporarily unavailable, Redwood falls back to a pre-authorized short-lived key escrow path for in-flight operations — this is controlled by a documented emergency-access procedure and requires Helix approval.
- Option B: External HSM reference (recommended for strict key custody). We can integrate with an external Cloud HSM that Helix controls (Helix provides the key references/URIs). Redwood will not have direct access to raw key material; only encrypted references and permitted KMS API calls. If the external HSM is unreachable, we can fail closed (requests error) or allow an emergency failover to Redwood-managed keys under an agreed SLA and change-control process.
- Option C: On-prem HSM appliance (higher integration effort). This is feasible but requires network connectivity and an agreed PKI/trust setup.

3) Performance trade-offs: Option B/C can add ~5–30ms per token depending on network and key wrapping strategy; we'll include measured estimates in the matrix.

4) Evidence & questionnaire: Marissa — please start the vendor security questionnaire intake. I'll attach a short KMS evidence bundle (key rotation policy excerpt, KMS integration diagram, HSM compatibility note).

Deliverables and timeline I will commit to:
- 1-page decision matrix (Option A/B/C) with latency/cost/operational notes — Ben (by 2026-12-07).
- SOC 2 Type II package (redacted) — Soojin (by 2026-12-04).
- Completed questionnaire draft — Marissa (initial pass by 2026-12-09).
